You can run OdooClaw with: Our models (OdooClaw Light 1.2B + Vision, published on HuggingFace) — 100% local, open source (MIT), free forever Your own models — any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: local (llama.cpp, oMLX/MLX, Ollama, vLLM) or cloud (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, Moonshot ...

sources.snippet: OdooClaw uses a model-centric configuration approach (model_list in config.json). You simply specify the vendor/model format to add new providers— zero code changes required!

sources.title: nicolasramos/odooclaw | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: OdooClaw is an ultra-lightweight, high-performance AI assistant written in Go, specifically engineered for native integration with Odoo ERP. Originally forked from PicoClaw it retains a microscopic footprint (under 10MB RAM) while providing a robust bridge between Large Language Models (LLMs) and the Odoo ORM via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
